_help: List of events. To add an event, copy one { ... } block, paste it after a comma, and change it. Fields: id = short unique name, no spaces (used in links like #events/porchfest); category = "main" (Kickoff Sep 2028 / Finale Sep 2029), "community" (Year of Celebration) or "ongoing" (leading-up and year-round projects; no date needed); status = "planned" or "proposed" (shows a 'Proposed' badge: an idea still being decided); start/end = "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" (Bedford time) or just "YYYY-MM-DD"; dateTBD = true while the date isn't confirmed (dateLabel is shown instead; on the Calendar the event appears in a 'Date to be announced' row for its month); tentativeDate = true (with dateTBD) when the planned day is known but not final: the event then appears on that day in the Calendar, marked 'tentative'; host = who is organizing (optional; only list organizations or people who have agreed); image = optional photo in assets/images/originals/; featured = true to force it into the Home page spotlight. Source: 'Year of celebration Rev B' planning sheet. TENTATIVE: dates and details will change.

notice.title: Tentative Schedule
notice.text: This is our working plan for the Tricentennial year (planning sheet Rev B, October 2026). Events, dates, and hosts will change as planning continues, and events marked “Proposed” are still being decided. Please check back for updates!
